The Kingpin of Crime.text: Pile grade (Oct, before the sacrifice re-read and today's land fix):

Stadium Headliner.text: 1-drop with mobilize 1; Isshin doubles it, so two attacking 1/1s every attack from turn 2. Fixes the deck's empty 1-slot and feeds the end-step sacrifice payoffs.

Sanguine Syphoner.text: 2-drop; 'whenever this creature attacks, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1' fires twice under Isshin. Cheap early pressure.

Vampire Gourmand.text: 2-drop; on attack sacrifice another creature, draw a card and can't be blocked. Isshin doubles it: sacrifice two mobilize tokens that die at end step anyway, draw two. Fixes thin card draw and fires Vraan, Nightblade, Sothera, Dictate.

Kavaron Harrier.text: 1-drop; pay {2} on attack for a tapped-and-attacking 2/2 Robot. Doubled, but each copy costs {2} — mana-hungry.

Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd.text: 2-drop with flash; on attack exile another nonland permanent until end step. Doubled: can blink two of your ETB creatures, or remove two blockers for the turn.

Seasoned Consultant.text: 2-drop; +2/+0 when you attack with three or more, doubled to +4/+0. Easy to turn on with mobilize.

Anguished Unmaking.text: {1}{W}{B} instant: exile target nonland permanent. The clean answer to a compounding engine the deck lost to.

Ruthless Lawbringer.text: 3-drop creature; ETB sacrifice another creature to destroy target nonland permanent. The sacrifice also fires the death payoffs; a body plus an answer.

Worthy Cost.text: {B}: sacrifice a creature, exile target creature or planeswalker. In main phase 2, sacrifice a mobilize token that would die anyway — 1-mana exile removal that triggers the death payoffs.

Eaten Alive.text: {B}: sacrifice a creature (or pay {3}{B}), exile target creature or planeswalker. Same token line as Worthy Cost, with a fallback cost.

Banishing Light.text: {2}{W}: exile any nonland permanent an opponent controls. Answers enchantments, artifacts and planeswalkers the creature removal can't.

Stormplain Detainment.text: {2}{W}: exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls. A second Banishing Light.

Solitary Cell.text: {R}{W} artifact: exile a nonland permanent with MV 3 or less. Turn-2 answer to an early engine; misses big threats.

Venat, Heart of Hydaelyn.text: 3-drop; 'whenever you cast a legendary spell, draw a card', once each turn. Most of this deck's creatures are legendary, so it draws nearly every turn — the card-advantage fix.
